stories.title: Stampeders fire defensive co-ordinator Slowik after missing 2026 playoffs
stories.summary: CALGARY — The Calgary Stampeders have fired defensive co-ordinator Bob Slowik after missing the CFL playoffs for the second time in three seasons.

stories.title: Armed men take hostages in Cartagena, one of Colombia's top tourist destinations
stories.summary: BOGOTA, Colombia (AP) — A group of armed men with their faces covered seized a supermarket in the Colombian city of Cartagena on Tuesday and are holding an unknown number of hostages, Colombian police said.

stories.title: Author Galloway's lawyer asks B.C. court for millions in defamation award
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — Author and former University of British Columbia professor Steven Galloway is seeking nearly $5 million in rarely-awarded special damages in his defamation lawsuit against the woman who accused him of rape.

stories.title: McGuinty says he can't explain Pentagon's criticism of Canada's defence spending
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Defence Minister David McGuinty says he can’t "divine" the thinking behind the Pentagon’s recent criticism of Canada’s defence spending.

stories.title: B.C. Green leader wants to pave path for more young people in legislature
stories.summary: Emily Lowan, who was sworn into office as MLA for Saanich North and the Islands, says it’s important for more young people to get involved in politics.

stories.title: Alberta bill poses potential risk to TC Energy growth plans, CIBC analysts say
stories.summary: CALGARY — Analysts at CIBC Capital Markets say proposed Alberta legislation creates uncertainty around TC Energy Corp.'s plans to expand the vast pipeline network it has long operated in the province.

stories.title: Minister says one-time plan for permanent residents capped at 200,000 entries
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Immigration Minister Lena Diab says the government has no intention of granting permanent residency to more than 200,000 people in its one-time plan in addition to its broad target.
